# Load Data
```{r load data, echo=FALSE}
setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path))
stopvape_raw <- read_csv("stopvape_with_mood_class.csv", col_names = TRUE)

stopvape <- stopvape_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(mood_class))

cat("Challenges:", nrow(stopvape))
cat(" Participants:", n_distinct(stopvape$userid))

stopvape.dd <- datadist(stopvape)
options(datadist = "stopvape.dd")
```

# Data Exploration
# mood_class: LCGA-derived mood trajectory class per challenge.
# 1 = "Poor and Improving"
# 2 = "Fair and Depressing"
# 3 = "Good and Improving"
# Reference = Class 2 ("Fair and Depressing")
```{r data exploration, echo=FALSE}
# completeness check
stopvape_complete <- na.omit(stopvape)
sum(is.na(stopvape_complete))

# Proportion with at least one missing value = 75.43478
nrow(stopvape[!complete.cases(stopvape), ])/nrow(stopvape)*100

summary(stopvape)
colSums(is.na(stopvape))
```

# Descriptive data based on mood class
```{r descriptive by mood}
stopvape %>%
  distinct(userid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = mood_class,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_p() %>%
  add_overall()
```

# Prepare data
```{r}
# Factor labels for gender and sexual orientation (unchanged)
stopvape$gender_adj <- factor(stopvape$gender,
                              levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                              labels = c("Men", "Women", "Others"))
stopvape$sexorient_adj <- factor(stopvape$sexorient,
                                 levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                                 labels = c("Heterosexual", "LGBTQ",
                                            "Asexual/Undisclosed"))

# Clean implausible age values
stopvape <- stopvape %>%
  mutate(age = ifelse(nchar(as.character(age)) > 3, NA, age))

summary(stopvape$age)

#encode mood_class with class 2(Fair_Depressing) as reference 

stopvape$mood_class <- factor (as.character(stopvape$mood_class), 
                                 levels = c("2", "1", "3"), 
                                 labels = c("Fair_Depressing", "Poor_Improving", "Good_Improving"))

```

# Missing data and multiple imputations 
```{r mice}
skim(stopvape)
summary(stopvape, na.rm = TRUE)

#explore patterns of missingness
na.pat <- naclus(stopvape[,-1])
naplot(na.pat)

vis_miss(stopvape)
gg_miss_var(stopvape)
gg_miss_var(stopvape, show_pct = TRUE)
gg_miss_case(stopvape)

n_var_miss(stopvape)
ggplot(data = stopvape,
       mapping = aes(x = Time.elapsed, y = mood_class)) +
  geom_miss_point()

# variable vector for MICE (selected variables)

v <- c("userid",
       "age",
       "gender_adj",
       "sexorient_adj",
       "race",
       "ecu11b_1",
       "ecu16_1",
       "ecu8_1",
       "cur_csmk_1",
       "cur_can_1",
       "cur_alc_1",
       "cur_otob_1",
       "status",
       "Time.elapsed",
       "mood_class"
       )

stopvape$userid <- as.factor(stopvape$userid)

set.seed(3098)
stopvape.mice <- mice(stopvape[, v], m = 5, method = "cart")

# Prevent userid from being imputed
stopvape.mice$method["userid"] <- ""

stopvape.mice$method
plot(stopvape.mice)

densityplot(stopvape.mice)
densityplot(stopvape.mice, ~ mood_class |.imp)
```
# CPH on pooled imputed data
```{r CPH}
# unadjusted model
fit1 <- with(stopvape.mice,
             coxph(
               Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~ factor(mood_class) + cluster(userid))
             )
pooled_fit1 <- pool(fit1)

# model with mood+covariates
fit2 <- with(
  stopvape.mice,
  coxph(
    Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~
      factor(mood_class) +
      ecu11b_1 +    # Time to first vape after waking up (0= 0-5 mins, 1=6-30 mins, 2= >30 mins)
      ecu16_1 +     # Self-perceived addiction to e-cigarette (0= Less addicted, 1= Very addicted)
      ecu8_1 +      # Frequency of current vaping in past month
      cur_csmk_1 +  # Smoking cigarette in past 30 days (y/n)
      cur_can_1 +   # Used cannabis in past 30 days(y/n)
      cur_alc_1 +   # Drink alcohol in past 30 days (y/n)
      cur_otob_1 +  # Used other tobacco products in past 30 days (y/n)
      cluster(userid)
  )
)

pooled_fit2 <- pool(fit2)

summary(
  pooled_fit2,
  conf.int   = TRUE,
  exponentiate = TRUE
)

# adjusted for substance use and substance use and demographics
fit3 <- with(stopvape.mice,
             coxph(Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~ 
                     factor(mood_class) + 
                     age + 
                     gender_adj +
                     sexorient_adj +
                     race +
                     ecu11b_1 +
                     ecu16_1 +
                     ecu8_1 +
                     cur_csmk_1 +
                     cur_can_1 +
                     cur_alc_1 +
                     cur_otob_1 +
                     cluster(userid)
                   )
             )

pooled_fit3 <- pool(fit3)

summary(
  pooled_fit3,
  conf.int   = TRUE,
  exponentiate = TRUE
)

# mood+demographic only model 
fitdemo <- with(
  stopvape.mice,
  coxph(
    Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~
      factor(mood_class) +
      age +
      gender_adj +
      sexorient_adj +
      race +
      cluster(userid)
  )
)

pooled_fitdemo <- pool(fitdemo)

summary(
  pooled_fitdemo,
  conf.int   = TRUE,
  exponentiate = TRUE
)
# interact model: mood_class x gender
fit_interact <- with(
  stopvape.mice,
  coxph(
    Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~
      factor(mood_class) * gender_adj +
      cluster(userid)
  )
)

pooled_fit_interact <- pool(fit_interact)

summary(
  pooled_fit_interact,
  conf.int   = TRUE,
  exponentiate = TRUE
)

#AIC comparisons
sapply(fit1$analyses, AIC)
sapply(fit2$analyses, AIC)
sapply(fit3$analyses, AIC)
sapply(fitdemo$analyses, AIC)
sapply(fit_interact$analyses, AIC)

mean(sapply(fit1$analyses, AIC))
mean(sapply(fit2$analyses, AIC))
mean(sapply(fit3$analyses, AIC))
mean(sapply(fitdemo$analyses, AIC))
mean(sapply(fit_interact$analyses, AIC))

#BIC
sapply(fit1$analyses, BIC)
sapply(fit2$analyses, BIC)
sapply(fit3$analyses, BIC)
sapply(fitdemo$analyses, BIC)
sapply(fit_interact$analyses, BIC)

mean(sapply(fit1$analyses, BIC))
mean(sapply(fit2$analyses,BIC))
mean(sapply(fit3$analyses,BIC))
mean(sapply(fitdemo$analyses,BIC))
mean(sapply(fit_interact$analyses,BIC))
```
# Gender-stratified analysis
```{r gender stratified analysis}
# Overall gender distribution
table(stopvape$gender_adj)
prop.table(table(stopvape$gender_adj)) * 100

#men adjusted
cox_mi_men <- with(
  stopvape.mice,
  coxph(
    Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~
      factor(mood_class) +
      age +
      sexorient_adj +
      race +
      ecu11b_1 +
      ecu16_1 +
      ecu8_1 +
      cur_csmk_1 +
      cur_can_1 +
      cur_alc_1 +
      cur_otob_1 +
      cluster(userid),
    subset = (gender_adj == "Men")
  )
)
pooled_men <- pool(cox_mi_men)

# women adjusted
cox_mi_women <- with(
  stopvape.mice,
  coxph(
    Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~
      factor(mood_class) +
      age +
      sexorient_adj +
      race +
      ecu11b_1 +
      ecu16_1 +
      ecu8_1 +
      cur_csmk_1 +
      cur_can_1 +
      cur_alc_1 +
      cur_otob_1 +
      cluster(userid),
    subset = (gender_adj == "Women")
  )
)
pooled_women <- pool(cox_mi_women)

#others adjusted
cox_mi_others <- with(
  stopvape.mice,
  coxph(
    Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~
      factor(mood_class) +
      age +
      sexorient_adj +
      race +
      ecu11b_1 +
      ecu16_1 +
      ecu8_1 +
      cur_csmk_1 +
      cur_can_1 +
      cur_alc_1 +
      cur_otob_1 +
      cluster(userid),
    subset = (gender_adj == "Others")
  )
)
pooled_others <- pool(cox_mi_others)

summary(pooled_men,    conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
summary(pooled_women,  conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
summary(pooled_others, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)

```

# KM survival curve by mood class

```{r km curve}
surv_elapsed <- Surv(time  = stopvape$Time.elapsed,
                     event = stopvape$status
                     )
relapse.km <- npsurv(surv_elapsed ~ mood_class, data = stopvape)

km_plot <- ggsurvplot(
  relapse.km,
  data = stopvape,
  size = 1,
  palette = c("#6A9EC2", "#E07B54", "#5BAD72"),  # 3 colours
  pval= TRUE,
  xlim = c(0, 20),
  break.time.by = 10,
  risk.tabe = TRUE,
  risk.table.col = "strata",
  legend.labs = c(
    "Fair and Depressing",# Class 2
    "Poor and Improving",# Class 1
    "Good and Improving"# Class 3
  ),
  risk.table.height = 0.25,
  ggtheme = theme_bw(),
  title = "Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves by LCGA Mood Class", 
  xlab = "Day of quit attempt (from first mood recording)", 
  ylab = "Survival probability until vaping relapse"
)
# Time point: 7 days
summary(relapse.km, times = 7)

# 30 days
summary(km_plot, times = 30)

p <- arrange_ggsurvplots(list(km_plot), print = FALSE)

ggsave("km_plot.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 10,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300
       )

```

# Log-rank test and median survival time
```{r survival time}
# Log-rank (Mantel-Haenszel) test
sur.mh <- survdiff(surv_elapsed ~ mood_class, data = stopvape)
sur.mh

# Median survival time per mood class
survfit(surv_elapsed ~ mood_class, data = stopvape)
```
# Sensitivity analysis: First quit challenge per participant
```{r sensitivity analysis}
stopvape_firstquit <- stopvape %>%
  arrange(userid, challenge_id) %>%
  distinct(userid, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("First-quit subset n:", nrow(stopvape_firstquit))
cat(" Unique users:",n_distinct(stopvape_firstquit$userid))

stopvape_firstquit$mood_class <- factor(
  as.character(stopvape_firstquit$mood_class),
  levels = c("Fair_Depressing", "Poor_Improving", "Good_Improving")
)

# MICE
v <- c(
  "userid", 
  "age", 
  "gender_adj",
  "sexorient_adj",
  "race",
  "ecu11b_1", 
  "ecu16_1", 
  "ecu8_1",
  "cur_csmk_1", 
  "cur_can_1", 
  "cur_alc_1", 
  "cur_otob_1",
  "status", 
  "Time.elapsed", 
  "mood_class"
)
stopvape_firstquit$userid <- as.factor(stopvape_firstquit$userid)

stopvape_firstquit$userid <- as.factor(stopvape_firstquit$userid)

set.seed(3098)
stopvape_firstquit.mice <- mice(stopvape_firstquit[, v], m = 5, method = "cart")
stopvape_firstquit.mice$method["userid"] <- ""
stopvape_firstquit.mice$method
plot(stopvape_firstquit.mice)
densityplot(stopvape_firstquit.mice)
densityplot(stopvape_firstquit.mice, ~ mood_class |.imp)
```

```{r first-quit cph}

fit1_firstquit <- with(
  stopvape_firstquit.mice,
  coxph(Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~ factor(mood_class) + cluster(userid))
)

fit2_firstquit <- with(
  stopvape_firstquit.mice,
  coxph(Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~
          factor(mood_class) +
          ecu11b_1 + ecu16_1 + ecu8_1 +
          cur_csmk_1 + cur_can_1 + cur_alc_1 + cur_otob_1 +
          cluster(userid))
)

fit3_firstquit <- with(
  stopvape_firstquit.mice,
  coxph(Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~
          factor(mood_class) + age + gender_adj + sexorient_adj + race +
          ecu11b_1 + ecu16_1 + ecu8_1 +
          cur_csmk_1 + cur_can_1 + cur_alc_1 + cur_otob_1 +
          cluster(userid))
)

fitdemo_firstquit <- with(
  stopvape_firstquit.mice,
  coxph(Surv(Time.elapsed, status) ~
          factor(mood_class) + age + gender_adj + sexorient_adj + race +
          cluster(userid))
)


pooled_fit1_firstquit<- pool(fit1_firstquit)
pooled_fit2_firstquit<- pool(fit2_firstquit)
pooled_fit3_firstquit<- pool(fit3_firstquit)
pooled_fitdemo_firstquit <- pool(fitdemo_firstquit)

summary(pooled_fit1_firstquit,    conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
summary(pooled_fit2_firstquit,    conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
summary(pooled_fit3_firstquit,    conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
summary(pooled_fitdemo_firstquit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
```
